name: ALSO Holding AG
summary: ALSO Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a technology services provider for the ICT industry in Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Poland, and internationally. The company distributes hardware and software products, including printers. It also offers information technology, Internet of Things, and digital platform services; and cloud and as-a-service, logistics, and finance services. In addition, the company offers cloud marketplace; artificial intelligence, virtualization, streaming, and cloud gaming; cybersecurity; training and events; aftersales; and recycling and refurbishment services.
